request.input:
Write an employer-facing cover letter tailored to this job. Use only candidate facts from the source. Preserve contribution level, shared results, dates, credential status and academic/project context. Do not turn job requirements into candidate history. Choose the strongest relevant evidence, retain useful concrete detail, and write clear natural professional English. Make a focused case through one or two relevant examples rather than reciting the résumé. Avoid generic praise and invented motivation. Use 2–4 paragraphs, at most 320 words, a salutation and signoff.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Freelance Interior Photo Editor position with Example C06 Services. As a self-employed Freelance Photo Editor since 2022, I have edited residential interiors in Lightroom from photographers’ files and colour-reference notes. My portfolio is available at https://example.com/sofia-interiors.

For the 2025 Riverside Apartment Series for Example Interior Photographer, I matched colour across adjoining rooms affected by mixed window and ceiling light. Using the photographer’s reference frame and local white-balance masks, I produced a consistent set that the photographer accepted after one review round. This work required maintaining the appearance of the spaces while addressing varied lighting between rooms.

In my freelance work, I also correct white balance and vertical alignment without removing permanent room features. I deliver named image sets in the requested dimensions and check them against the photographer’s shot list, supporting accurate, specification-ready delivery.
